lines.en: Uh, little lady, this is no squirrel.
Your squirrel. Is he nutty for nuts?
Dear, there's nary squirrel upon my face.
Once again, this is a mustache.
My name is Samantha Puckett, I'm from Seattle and I love fried chicken!
It's true, she does, she loves chicken.
No, I was off balance when I turned to walk off.
Oh, no one will notice that.
You keep fried chicken in your purse?
Uh-huh, you did my doorbell thing.
No, it was like that when I got here.
'Cause the electricity went out last night and all the food spoiled so Spencer threw it out.
So what am I supposed to eat?
Well, you could order a pizza, or there's a Chinese place that delivers, but I'm not sure.
Carly, Sam bit my hand off and then she swallowed it.
Are you Sam right now or Melanie?
I don't know, does this hurt?
- Yeah, it hurt! - Then I'm Sam.
- Melanie's. - Oh, so this is Melanie's smoothie.
Even twins have to go sometimes.
Well, then maybe I'll just wait here till Melanie comes out of the bathroom.
Briggs came back to detention and saw I ditched.
Uh, just tell her I had to puke. I'll be back there in five minutes.
Don't you have to wait for Melanie?
Tell her I'll meet her later at home.
Oh, she had to go back to detention.
Yes, and isn't it interesting how Sam had to leave right before you showed up here?
- Is he still on this? - Uh-huh.
I will say, it's impressive that you changed your clothes and hair so fast.
Freddie, I'm really Melanie. I'm really Sam's sister.
You haven't fed us a bite of food since last Tuesday.
I think it was me and day.
They're colorful and pointy, you ungrateful nuggets.
I ain't gonna give you no soup!
I ain't gonna give you no soup!
I ain't gonna give you no soup!
Why? It's the color of gravy!
Now go clean the men's room.
- Go clean... - No, no, no, no, no!
I mean, I mean, can't you get a guy employee to do it?
